variants.A: Yes, it really is free. We genuinely believe that anyone considering dental treatment abroad should have the chance to understand the process clearly before making a decision. That's exactly why we organise these Roadshows — so you can meet our dentist, ask everything openly, and leave with clarity. There's no fee and no obligation.
variants.B: Yes, there's absolutely no charge to attend. The consultation is free, and you're not committing to anything. It's simply an opportunity to get honest, professional information face to face.
variants.C: Yes, it's completely free to attend. You can ask all your questions, discuss your situation, and receive guidance without paying anything.

variants.A: It will take place in a hotel meeting room in the city centre. Once I confirm your attendance, I'll send you the full address, time, and location link.
variants.B: We're hosting it in a central hotel venue for private one-to-one meetings. As soon as your slot is confirmed, I'll share the exact location details with you.
variants.C: It's being held in a hotel conference room so we can meet comfortably and privately. I'll send you the full details right after we schedule your time.

variants.A: You'll meet {{team.dentist.name}} face to face. If you have an X-ray, you can bring it and review it together. You'll talk through possible treatment options, timelines, travel arrangements, aftercare — everything from A to Z. It's really about making sure you fully understand the journey before deciding anything.
variants.B: Think of it as a clarity meeting. We'll look at your current situation, discuss what might be suitable for you, and explain the full treatment process — including how many days you'd need, how it works step by step, and what happens afterwards.
variants.C: It's a private one-to-one conversation with the dentist. If you have reports or X-rays, we'll review them. Then you'll receive a clear explanation of the treatment approach, the process, and what to expect — so there are no surprises later.

faqs_12x3.question_real: Will any treatment be done there?

variants.A: No treatment will be carried out during the Roadshow 🙂 It's purely a consultation and planning session, so you can make an informed decision before travelling.
variants.B: No procedures take place there. It's just an in-person discussion and evaluation to understand your options clearly.
variants.C: Nothing clinical will be done at the event. It's simply a chance to meet the dentist and plan properly. Any treatment would take place later at our clinic.

faqs_12x3.question_real: Do I need to pay anything after?

variants.A: No, there's no obligation at all. After the Roadshow, you'll have all the information you need — and then the decision is entirely yours. We only move forward if you feel comfortable.
variants.B: You're not required to commit to anything. The purpose is to give you clarity, not pressure.
variants.C: No payment is required unless you decide to proceed with treatment later on. And that choice is completely up to you.

variants.A: If you have a recent X-ray, that's very helpful — it allows the dentist to give more detailed guidance. But if you don't have one, that's absolutely fine too.
variants.B: Yes, please bring it if you have one. If not, don't worry — we can still have a very useful discussion.
variants.C: An X-ray helps us be more precise, but it's not mandatory. You're welcome either way.

faqs_12x3.question_real: Can I bring someone with me?

variants.A: Of course — you're very welcome to bring a family member or a friend. Many people do, and it's completely free for them as well.
variants.B: Yes, absolutely. If it makes you feel more comfortable, please bring someone along.
variants.C: You can definitely bring someone with you. We're happy to answer their questions too.

variants.A: Appointments usually take around 20–30 minutes. If you have more questions, we can take a little longer — we won't rush you.
variants.B: Around half an hour on average, depending on how detailed the discussion is.
variants.C: It's typically 20–30 minutes, but we adjust based on your needs.

faqs_12x3.question_real: Why are you doing this in {{campaign.cities_human}}?

variants.A: That's a very fair question. We've treated many patients from this region over the years, and we've learned that people really value meeting the dentist before travelling. We believe important health decisions should start with trust and clarity — that's why we come to meet you in person.
variants.B: We know travelling abroad for treatment comes with questions. Instead of asking you to decide from a distance, we prefer to meet face to face and answer everything properly.
variants.C: This region has been one of the places where many of our patients come from. Hosting a Roadshow allows us to connect directly, answer concerns honestly, and build confidence before any travel happens.

variants.A: The cost depends on your specific case — the number of teeth involved, the type of treatment, materials used, and your overall oral condition. That's why we prefer to evaluate properly first, so we can give you accurate information instead of guessing.
variants.B: I completely understand wanting to know the price. The exact cost becomes clear once the dentist reviews your situation and outlines the treatment plan. That way, everything is transparent and tailored to you.
variants.C: Because every case is different, we avoid giving random estimates. During the Roadshow, once we understand your needs, we can explain the pricing structure clearly.

faqs_12x3.question_real: Do you organise hotel and transfers?

variants.A: If you'd like, we can guide you through the whole process — from airport transfers to accommodation options. Some patients prefer to organise everything themselves, others prefer support. We're flexible. If you want, you can also reach us on {{clinic.phone}}.
variants.B: Yes, we assist with planning if needed. During the Roadshow, we explain how the travel and clinic schedule works step by step.
variants.C: We're happy to help coordinate the process so it feels smooth and stress-free. You can choose the level of support you prefer.
